```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

dir.create("data/tcga", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- TCGA-COAD (STAR counts) ---
query_coad <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-COAD",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts"
)

GDCdownload(query_coad, directory = "data/tcga")
coad_se <- GDCprepare(query_coad, directory = "data/tcga")

saveRDS(coad_se, file = "data/tcga/TCGA-COAD_se.rds")
saveRDS(assay(coad_se), file = "data/tcga/TCGA-COAD_counts.rds")

dim(assay(coad_se))
```

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)

dir.create("data/tcga", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ===== 1) Extract counts + TPM from both cohorts =====
coad_counts <- assay(coad_se, "unstranded")
coad_tpm    <- assay(coad_se, "tpm_unstrand")

read_counts <- assay(read_se, "unstranded")
read_tpm    <- assay(read_se, "tpm_unstrand")

# ===== 2) Save individual cohort objects =====
saveRDS(coad_se,     "data/tcga/TCGA-COAD_se.rds")
saveRDS(coad_counts, "data/tcga/TCGA-COAD_counts_unstranded.rds")
saveRDS(coad_tpm,    "data/tcga/TCGA-COAD_tpm_unstrand.rds")

saveRDS(read_se,     "data/tcga/TCGA-READ_se.rds")
saveRDS(read_counts, "data/tcga/TCGA-READ_counts_unstranded.rds")
saveRDS(read_tpm,    "data/tcga/TCGA-READ_tpm_unstrand.rds")

# ===== 3) Merge COAD + READ by common genes =====
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(coad_counts), rownames(read_counts))

crc_counts <- cbind(
  coad_counts[common_genes, ],
  read_counts[common_genes, ]
)

crc_tpm <- cbind(
  coad_tpm[common_genes, ],
  read_tpm[common_genes, ]
)

saveRDS(crc_counts, "data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_counts_merged.rds")
saveRDS(crc_tpm,    "data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_tpm_merged.rds")

cat("Merged CRC counts dim:", dim(crc_counts), "\n")
cat("Merged CRC TPM dim:", dim(crc_tpm), "\n")

# ===== 4) Create a sample->patient barcode map (needed for clinical merge) =====
sample_barcodes <- colnames(crc_counts)
patient_barcodes <- substr(sample_barcodes, 1, 12)

sample_map <- data.frame(
  sample_barcode = sample_barcodes,
  patient_barcode = patient_barcodes,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

saveRDS(sample_map, "data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_sample_patient_map.rds")
head(sample_map)
```
```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Use the rowData from one of your prepared objects (coad_se/read_se have it)
# This has Ensembl IDs and gene_name columns.
row_anno <- as.data.frame(rowData(coad_se))

# Common columns in TCGAbiolinks rowData: gene_id and gene_name
# gene_id often includes version: ENSG... .xx
head(row_anno[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")])

# Build mapping: Ensembl (no version) -> gene symbol
ens_id <- gsub("\\..*$", "", row_anno$gene_id)
symb   <- row_anno$gene_name

map_df <- data.frame(
  ensembl = ens_id,
  symbol = symb,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  distinct(ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "")

# Apply mapping to your merged TPM matrix
crc_tpm_log <- log2(crc_tpm + 1)

ens_rows <- gsub("\\..*$", "", rownames(crc_tpm_log))
m <- match(ens_rows, map_df$ensembl)

# Keep only mapped genes
crc_tpm_log_mapped <- crc_tpm_log[!is.na(m), ]
new_symbols <- map_df$symbol[m[!is.na(m)]]
rownames(crc_tpm_log_mapped) <- new_symbols

# If multiple Ensembl map to same symbol, collapse by mean
crc_tpm_log_gene <- rowsum(crc_tpm_log_mapped, group = rownames(crc_tpm_log_mapped))

cat("Before mapping:", nrow(crc_tpm_log), "genes\n")
cat("After mapping+collapse:", nrow(crc_tpm_log_gene), "unique gene symbols\n")

saveRDS(crc_tpm_log_gene, "data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_tpm_log2_geneSymbol.rds")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Use rowData from coad_se (already in your workspace)
row_anno <- as.data.frame(rowData(coad_se))[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")]

# Remove Ensembl version suffix (.15, .6, etc.)
row_anno$ensembl <- sub("\\..*$", "", row_anno$gene_id)

map_df <- row_anno %>%
  select(ensembl, symbol = gene_name) %>%
  distinct(ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "")

# Prepare expression (log2(TPM+1))
crc_tpm_log <- log2(crc_tpm + 1)

# Remove version from expression rownames too
ens_rows <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(crc_tpm_log))

# Match expression rows to mapping
m <- match(ens_rows, map_df$ensembl)

# Keep only rows that map to a symbol
crc_tpm_log_mapped <- crc_tpm_log[!is.na(m), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(crc_tpm_log_mapped) <- map_df$symbol[m[!is.na(m)]]

# Collapse duplicate symbols by mean
crc_tpm_log_gene <- rowsum(crc_tpm_log_mapped, group = rownames(crc_tpm_log_mapped))

cat("Genes before:", nrow(crc_tpm_log), "\n")
cat("Genes after mapping+collapse:", nrow(crc_tpm_log_gene), "\n")

dir.create("data/tcga", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(crc_tpm_log_gene, "data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_tpm_log2_geneSymbol.rds")
```
```{r}
library(GSVA)

crc_tpm_log_gene <- readRDS("data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_tpm_log2_geneSymbol.rds")

immune_genes <- c("PTPRC","CD3D","CD3E","CD8A","CD8B","GZMB","PRF1","CXCL9","CXCL10","IFNG")
stromal_genes <- c("COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1","COL5A1","COL5A2","FN1","VCAN","SPARC","MMP2","MMP9","CXCL12","FAP")

cat("Immune genes matched:", sum(immune_genes %in% rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene)), "/", length(immune_genes), "\n")
cat("Stromal genes matched:", sum(stromal_genes %in% rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene)), "/", length(stromal_genes), "\n")

gene_sets <- list(
  Immune_Infiltration = intersect(immune_genes, rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene)),
  Stromal_ECM_Barrier = intersect(stromal_genes, rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene))
)

param <- ssgseaParam(expr = crc_tpm_log_gene, geneSets = gene_sets)
scores <- gsva(param)
scores_mat <- as.matrix(scores)

immune_score  <- as.numeric(scores_mat["Immune_Infiltration", ])
stromal_score <- as.numeric(scores_mat["Stromal_ECM_Barrier", ])

names(immune_score)  <- colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene)
names(stromal_score) <- colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene)

# Quartile thresholds
immune_low_cut   <- quantile(immune_score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
immune_high_cut  <- quantile(immune_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
stromal_low_cut  <- quantile(stromal_score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
stromal_high_cut <- quantile(stromal_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

phenotype <- rep("Other", length(immune_score))
names(phenotype) <- names(immune_score)

phenotype[immune_score <= immune_low_cut  & stromal_score >= stromal_high_cut] <- "Immune_Excluded"
phenotype[immune_score >= immune_high_cut & stromal_score <= stromal_low_cut ] <- "Immune_Inflamed"

print(table(phenotype))

saveRDS(immune_score,  "data/tcga/immune_score_ssgsea.rds")
saveRDS(stromal_score, "data/tcga/stromal_score_ssgsea.rds")
saveRDS(phenotype,     "data/tcga/immune_exclusion_phenotype.rds")
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(limma)

# Ensure crc_counts is loaded
# crc_counts <- readRDS("data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_counts_merged.rds")

keep_samples <- phenotype %in% c("Immune_Excluded", "Immune_Inflamed")
table(phenotype[keep_samples])

counts_sub <- crc_counts[, keep_samples]
group <- factor(phenotype[keep_samples], levels = c("Immune_Inflamed", "Immune_Excluded"))

dge <- DGEList(counts = counts_sub)
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(dge, group = group)
dge <- dge[keep_genes, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

design <- model.matrix(~ group)
v <- voom(dge, design, plot = TRUE)

fit <- lmFit(v, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

de <- topTable(fit, coef = "groupImmune_Excluded", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
de$ensembl_id <- rownames(de)

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(de, "results/DE_ImmuneExcluded_vs_Inflamed_limma_voom.csv", row.names = FALSE)

sig <- subset(de, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1)
write.csv(sig, "results/DE_SIG_ImmuneExcluded_vs_Inflamed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Significant genes:", nrow(sig), "\n")
head(sig, 10)
```

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# Use significant genes only
sig_genes <- unique(na.omit(de$symbol[de$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(de$logFC) > 1]))

# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
entrez_ids <- bitr(sig_genes,
                   fromType = "SYMBOL",
                   toType = "ENTREZID",
                   OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# GO enrichment
ego <- enrichGO(gene = entrez_ids$ENTREZID,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                ont = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# KEGG enrichment
ekegg <- enrichKEGG(gene = entrez_ids$ENTREZID,
                    organism = "hsa",
                    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                    qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15)
dotplot(ekegg, showCategory = 15)
```

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(dplyr)

# 1) Clinical (COAD + READ)
clinical_coad <- GDCquery_clinic("TCGA-COAD", type = "clinical")
clinical_read <- GDCquery_clinic("TCGA-READ", type = "clinical")
clinical_all <- bind_rows(clinical_coad, clinical_read)

# 2) Create OS time + event
clinical_all <- clinical_all %>%
  transmute(
    patient = submitter_id,
    vital_status = vital_status,
    days_to_death = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(days_to_death)),
    days_to_last_follow_up = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(days_to_last_follow_up)),
    time = ifelse(!is.na(days_to_death), days_to_death, days_to_last_follow_up),
    status = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time))

# 3) Make sample->patient table from your expression matrix
# Ensure crc_tpm_log_gene exists; if not load it:
# crc_tpm_log_gene <- readRDS("data/tcga/TCGA_CRC_tpm_log2_geneSymbol.rds")

expr_samples <- colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene)

expr_meta <- data.frame(
  sample = expr_samples,
  patient = substr(expr_samples, 1, 12),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 4) Merge expression sample list with clinical survival
surv_df <- inner_join(expr_meta, clinical_all, by = "patient")

cat("Samples with survival:", nrow(surv_df), "\n")
table(surv_df$status)
summary(surv_df$time)

head(surv_df)
```
```{r}
library(survival)

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

genes_for_cox <- intersect(sig_strict$symbol, rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene))
cat("Genes available for Cox:", length(genes_for_cox), "\n")

# Expression matrix: samples x genes (so glmnet works later)
X_all <- t(crc_tpm_log_gene[genes_for_cox, surv_df$sample, drop = FALSE])
X_all <- as.matrix(X_all)

# Remove any columns with zero variance
sd_vec <- apply(X_all, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
X_all <- X_all[, sd_vec > 0, drop = FALSE]
genes_for_cox <- colnames(X_all)

cox_list <- vector("list", length(genes_for_cox))
names(cox_list) <- genes_for_cox

for (g in genes_for_cox) {
  x <- X_all[, g]
  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ x, data = surv_df), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    s <- summary(fit)
    cox_list[[g]] <- data.frame(
      gene = g,
      HR = s$coef[1, "exp(coef)"],
      p  = s$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    cox_list[[g]] <- NULL
  }
}

cox_res <- do.call(rbind, cox_list)
cox_res$adj_p <- p.adjust(cox_res$p, method = "BH")
cox_res <- cox_res[order(cox_res$adj_p), ]

sig_cox <- subset(cox_res, adj_p < 0.05)

cat("Cox significant genes (FDR<0.05):", nrow(sig_cox), "\n")

write.csv(cox_res, "results/univariate_cox_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sig_cox, "results/univariate_cox_significant.csv", row.names = FALSE)

head(sig_cox, 10)
```

```{r}
# Rebuild X_all using filtered samples
genes_for_cox <- intersect(sig_strict$symbol, rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene))

X_all2 <- t(crc_tpm_log_gene[genes_for_cox, surv_df2$sample, drop = FALSE])
X_all2 <- as.matrix(X_all2)

# Remove zero-variance genes
sd_vec <- apply(X_all2, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
X_all2 <- X_all2[, sd_vec > 0, drop = FALSE]

# Use your top 200 Cox genes (already computed in cox_res)
topN <- 200
lasso_genes <- head(cox_res$gene, topN)
lasso_genes <- intersect(lasso_genes, colnames(X_all2))

X_lasso <- X_all2[, lasso_genes, drop = FALSE]
y <- Surv(surv_df2$time, surv_df2$status)

library(glmnet)
set.seed(1)
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_lasso,
  y = y,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

plot(cvfit)

coef_mat <- coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se")
idx <- which(as.numeric(coef_mat) != 0)

signature <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(coef_mat)[idx],
  coef = as.numeric(coef_mat)[idx],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

signature <- signature[order(abs(signature$coef), decreasing = TRUE), ]
cat("Final signature size:", nrow(signature), "\n")
print(signature)

write.csv(signature, "results/lasso_signature_lambda1se.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# 1) Load DE table with gene symbols (created earlier)
# If you don't have this file, tell me and I’ll point to the right one in your folder.
de_sym <- read.csv("results/DE_with_symbols.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2) Recreate strict DE gene list (same thresholds you used)
sig_strict_genes <- unique(na.omit(de_sym$symbol[de_sym$adj.P.Val < 0.01 & abs(de_sym$logFC) > 1.5]))
cat("Strict genes (symbols):", length(sig_strict_genes), "\n")

# 3) Keep strict genes present in expression matrix
genes_for_cox <- intersect(sig_strict_genes, rownames(crc_tpm_log_gene))

# 4) Build X matrix on surv_df2 samples (samples x genes)

# Drop zero-variance genes

X_all2 <- X_all2[, sdv > 0, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
cox_p <- apply(X_all2, 2, function(x){
  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(y ~ x), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  summary(fit)$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
})

cox_res <- data.frame(
  gene = names(cox_p),
  p = as.numeric(cox_p),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p)) %>%
  arrange(p)

write.csv(cox_res, "results/univariate_cox_ranked_p.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 6) Take top 300 genes for penalised Cox
topN <- 300
lasso_genes <- head(cox_res$gene, topN)
X_lasso <- X_all2[, lasso_genes, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genes entering LASSO:", ncol(X_lasso), "\n")

# 7) Fit penalised Cox (LASSO) with CV
set.seed(1)
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_lasso,
  y = y,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

# 8) Pick lambda that gives exactly 13 genes (or closest)
beta <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit$glmnet.fit))   # genes x lambdas
n_genes <- colSums(beta != 0)

target <- 13
idx <- which.min(abs(n_genes - target))

cat("Closest signature size to", target, "is", n_genes[idx], "genes at lambda index", idx, "\n")

lambda_custom <- cvfit$glmnet.fit$lambda[idx]
coef_custom <- coef(cvfit$glmnet.fit, s = lambda_custom)

nz <- which(as.numeric(coef_custom) != 0)

signature_custom <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(coef_custom)[nz],
  coef = as.numeric(coef_custom)[nz],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Final signature size (custom):", nrow(signature_custom), "\n")
print(signature_custom)

# 9) Save signature so you don't lose it again
write.csv(signature_custom, "results/lasso_signature_lambda_custom.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(cvfit, "results/cvfit_custom.rds")
```

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(Biobase)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# 1) Load expression + phenotype (you already have eset/expr/pheno in memory)
expr <- exprs(eset)     # probes x samples
pheno <- pData(eset)

# 2) Load your final signature
signature_custom <- read.csv("results/lasso_signature_lambda_custom.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 3) Get platform annotation for probe -> gene symbol mapping
gpl_id <- annotation(eset)
gpl <- getGEO(gpl_id)
gpl_table <- Table(gpl)

# Identify symbol column (for GPL570 it's usually "Gene Symbol")
symbol_col_candidates <- c("Gene Symbol","GENE_SYMBOL","Gene symbol","Symbol","SYMBOL")
symbol_col <- symbol_col_candidates[symbol_col_candidates %in% colnames(gpl_table)][1]
if (is.na(symbol_col)) stop("No gene symbol column found in GPL table.")

map <- gpl_table[, c("ID", symbol_col)]
colnames(map) <- c("probe", "symbol")

# Clean symbols
map$symbol <- gsub(" ///.*$", "", map$symbol)
map$symbol <- trimws(map$symbol)

# Keep mapped probes
map <- map[map$probe %in% rownames(expr) & !is.na(map$symbol) & map$symbol != "", ]

# Map expression probes -> symbols
expr_mapped <- expr[map$probe, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(expr_mapped) <- map$symbol

# Collapse duplicate gene symbols by mean
expr_gene <- rowsum(expr_mapped, group = rownames(expr_mapped))

cat("GSE39582 gene-level matrix:", dim(expr_gene), "\n")

# 4) Build validation survival (OS)
# Convert months -> days (optional). You can also keep months; just be consistent.
pheno$os_time_months <- as.numeric(pheno[["os.delay (months):ch1"]])
pheno$os_event_raw <- pheno[["os.event:ch1"]]

# Clean event to 0/1
# Often stored like "0" / "1" or "censored" / "relapse"
pheno$os_event <- as.numeric(as.character(pheno$os_event_raw))
# If conversion produced NAs, handle alternative encodings:
if (all(is.na(pheno$os_event))) {
  pheno$os_event <- ifelse(grepl("1|death|dead|event", pheno$os_event_raw, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)
}

# Keep valid samples
val_df <- pheno %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(pheno)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time_months), os_time_months > 0, !is.na(os_event))

cat("Validation samples with OS:", nrow(val_df), "\n")
table(val_df$os_event)

# 5) Compute risk score in validation cohort using SAME coefficients
common <- intersect(signature_custom$gene, rownames(expr_gene))
cat("Signature genes matched in GSE39582:", length(common), "/", nrow(signature_custom), "\n")
print(common)

sig_val <- signature_custom[signature_custom$gene %in% common, ]
expr_val <- t(expr_gene[common, val_df$sample, drop = FALSE])  # samples x genes

# Z-score per gene for cross-platform stability
expr_val_z <- scale(expr_val)

risk_val <- as.numeric(expr_val_z[, sig_val$gene, drop = FALSE] %*% sig_val$coef)
val_df$risk_score <- risk_val

# Median split (validation)
cut <- median(val_df$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)
val_df$risk_group <- ifelse(val_df$risk_score >= cut, "High", "Low")
table(val_df$risk_group)

# 6) KM + Cox in validation cohort
fit_km_val <- survfit(Surv(os_time_months, os_event) ~ risk_group, data = val_df)

ggsurvplot(
  fit_km_val,
  data = val_df,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  title = "GSE39582 External Validation (OS)"
)

fit_cox_val <- coxph(Surv(os_time_months, os_event) ~ risk_score, data = val_df)
summary(fit_cox_val)
```

```{r}
  "patchwork","survival","survminer"

to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]

# Workflow diagram tools (optional but recommended)
if (!"DiagrammeR" %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]) install.packages("DiagrammeR")
if (!"DiagrammeRsvg" %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]) install.packages("DiagrammeRsvg")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

library(survival)
library(survminer)

# ---------------------------
# Output folder

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------
# Publication theme
# ---------------------------
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

ggsave_pub <- function(filename_base, plot, w = 6.5, h = 5) {
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
         plot = plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
         plot = plot, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
}
```

```{r}
de_sym <- read.csv("results/DE_with_symbols.csv")

vol <- de_sym %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(adj.P.Val, 1e-300)),
    significant = adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1
  )

  filter(significant) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  slice(1:12)

p3 <- ggplot(vol, aes(logFC, neglog10FDR)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey70","red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                  aes(label = symbol),
                  size = 3,
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Immune Excluded vs Inflamed",
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = expression(-log[10]("FDR"))) +
  theme_pub()

save_pub("Figure3_Volcano", p3)
```

```{r}
  fit_geo,
  data=val_df,

  legend.title="Risk Group",

)

print(p5)
```

```{r}
C_stage <- 0.63394656
C_risk <- 0.55610238
C_combined <- 0.6619601

df_c <- data.frame(
  Model=c("Stage only","Signature only","Stage + Signature"),
  C_index=c(C_stage,C_risk,C_combined)
)

ggplot(df_c, aes(Model,C_index)) +
  geom_col(width=0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label=round(C_index,3)), vjust=-0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1)) +
  labs(title="C-index Comparison",
       y="C-index", x=NULL) +
  theme_pub()
```

```{r}
  Step = 1:7,

    "Penalised Cox Regression (LASSO) – 13-Gene Signature",

)

kable(workflow_table,
```
